wheel_selection.note: pip tag order for CPython 3.14 on manylinux_2_39_x86_64 and older (the ubuntu-24.04 builder)

policy: OLIVE-hosted Creator archives never contain NVIDIA-published wheels (nvidia-*, cuda-* unless allowed below with an open licence) or wheels shown to bundle NVIDIA components (bundles_nvidia, with the evidence). First-run setup downloads those exact pinned files from PyPI and unpacks them into the OLIVE-owned runtime before it is registered (engineering decision "Option B+", not a legal determination).

packages.name: comfy-kitchen
packages.direct_evidence: comfy_kitchen/backends/cuda/_C.abi3.so statically links the NVIDIA CUDA runtime (cudart_static); the wheel's own licenses/NOTICE says so (PASS 2F audit).

Classifier: License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License

packages.name: cuda-bindings
packages.direct_evidence: cuda/bindings/_internal/runtime.cpython-314-x86_64-linux-gnu.so and runtime_ptds…so embed the NVIDIA CUDA runtime (cudart internals /cudart.shm.*, no libcudart dependency) although the wheel declares Apache-2.0 (PASS 2F-B+ audit, owner decision B++).

packages.name: torchvision
packages.direct_evidence: torchvision.libs bundles libcudart and libnvjpeg (auditwheel-vendored; PASS 2F audit).

packages.name: triton
packages.direct_evidence: triton/backends/nvidia bundles ptxas, ptxas-blackwell, cuobjdump, nvdisasm, CUPTI libraries and CUDA headers (PASS 2F audit).
